name: stats
eval: (async()=>{const g=window.__wl.game; const out={}; for (const [k,vs] of Object.entries(g.world.trees.variants)) out[k]=vs.map(v=>[v.lod0.bark.index.count/3|0, (v.lod0.leaves?v.lod0.leaves.index.count/3:0)|0, v.lod1.bark.index.count/3|0, (v.lod1.leaves?v.lod1.leaves.index.count/3:0)|0]); out.trees=g.world.trees.instances.length; out.props=g.world.props.items.length; let meshes=0, tris=0; g.world.props.group.traverse(o=>{if(o.isInstancedMesh){meshes++; tris+=o.count*(o.geometry.index?o.geometry.index.count/3:o.geometry.attributes.position.count/3);}}); out.propMeshes=meshes; out.propTris=tris|0; let tm=0, tt=0; g.world.town.group.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh){tm++; tt+=(o.geometry.index?o.geometry.index.count/3:0);}}); out.townMeshes=tm; out.townTris=tt|0; window.__stats=out; console.warn('STATS '+JSON.stringify(out));})()
